MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

3. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

5. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 7

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 30

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 88

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

15. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
